correctness.rationale: For every s>0, unitary conjugation converts the kernel into a positive nuclear Bessel series; polynomial density proves injectivity. Generalized Vandermonde and Cauchy–Binet yield all-order strict total positivity. The exact Gamma-Poisson mixture gives row mass bounded by \(q_s\)=1-(1+s)e^{-s}; detailed balance and a two-stage Cauchy–Schwarz inequality imply norm at most \(q_s\). Positive trace-class spectral calculus proves negative-real Fredholm zeros, physical-bias invertibility and inverse norms. Large-argument I1 asymptotics prove trace ~\(\sqrt{s/\pi}\). The independent script passed 186 finite numerical tests; finite tests are not infinite proofs.
